match.note: Day 3: Stumps - Sri Lanka trail by 30 runs

centre.headline: 1st Test · Sri Lanka tour of Pakistan, 2026

latest.text: Razaullah to Kusal Mendis, no run, beaten, short of a good length and angling across the right-hander - Mendis looks to run it down towards third man and missed. Razaullah stares at Mendis for a long time and the Sri Lankan captain just nods his head

commentary.text: Razaullah to Kusal Mendis, no run, beaten, short of a good length and angling across the right-hander - Mendis looks to run it down towards third man and missed. Razaullah stares at Mendis for a long time and the Sri Lankan captain just nods his head

Razaullah to Kusal Mendis, no run, Razaullah shortens the length and pushes one across the right-hander, Mendis shapes to drive and then lets it go. Didn't bounce a lot and it's awkwardly collected by the keeper
Razaullah to Kusal Mendis, no run, short of a good length and angling across the right-hander, left alone
Razaullah to Dhananjaya, no run, Razaullah shortens the length outside off - DDS gets right behind the line as he defended it to the off-side

Razaullah to Dhananjaya, no run, that was close, short of a good length and just outside off - DDS's feet is rooted to the crease as he stays on the back-foot, was looking to drive and squeezes an inside edge onto the pad
Razaullah to Kusal Mendis, 1 run, fuller length delivery on the pads, Mendis leans across and pushes it in front of mid-on for a quick single

commentary.title: End of over 101 · 2 runs
commentary.summary: SL 401/4 · Dhananjaya de Silva · Saqib Khan

commentary.text: Saqib Khan to Dhananjaya, no run, tad fuller and angling back into the right-hander - DDS watches it closely and defends it with soft hands
Saqib Khan to Dhananjaya, no run, on a good length and just outside off - DDS lets the ball come and defends it to the off-side
Saqib Khan to Dhananjaya, no run, tad fuller and just outside off - DDS plays with soft hands and runs it towards the slip cordon
Saqib Khan to Dhananjaya, no run, fuller length delivery and shaping away from outside off, left alone
Saqib Khan to Dhananjaya, no run, on a good length and around off, DDS plays half-forward and defends it back at the bowler

Saqib Khan to Dhananjaya, 2 runs, an uppish drive, but the ball pops well wide of cover - fuller length delivery outside off and DDS was early into the shot, the bottom-hand came off on impact and he was in no control, comes back for the second and brings up SL's 200
Abbas to Kusal Mendis, no run, fuller length delivery and shaping away from outside off - Mendis doesn't need to play at those, left alone
Abbas to Kusal Mendis, no run, tad fuller and at the stumps, Mendis presses across and defends it back at the bowler
Abbas to Kusal Mendis, no run, on a good length and at the stumps, Mendis prods across and defends it back at the bowler

Abbas to Kusal Mendis, no run, edged and the ball drops short of Salman Agha at second slip, pitched up in that channel just outside off and the length drew Mendis into the push, he did so with fairly hard hands, but the ball went straight down
Abbas to Kusal Mendis, no run, fuller length delivery and shaping away from outside off, left alone
Abbas to Kusal Mendis, no run, short of a good length and just outside off - Mendis stays besides the line and defends it to the off-side

commentary.title: End of over 99 · 5 runs
commentary.summary: SL 399/4 · Dhananjaya de Silva · Salman Agha

commentary.text: Salman Agha to Dhananjaya, no run, tossed up on middle and leg - DDS goes back and defends it to the on-side
Salman Agha to Dhananjaya, no run, flighted around off - a half-forward DDS blocks it out
Salman Agha to Dhananjaya, no run, Salman tosses one on the leg-stump line, defended to the on-side
Salman Agha to Dhananjaya, FOUR, DDS comes down the pitch, gets close to the ball and then lifts it through the line, high and over long-off for a boundary
Salman Agha to Dhananjaya, no run, flighted delivery outside off - DDS goes right back and stabs it to the off-side
Salman Agha to Kusal Mendis, 1 run, tossed up just outside off - Mendis makes room and dabs it behind square on the off-side for a single

commentary.title: End of over 98 · 1 run
commentary.summary: SL 394/4 · Dhananjaya de Silva · Mohammad Abbas

commentary.text: Abbas to Dhananjaya, no run
Abbas to Kusal Mendis, 1 run, length ball on the pads, flicked down to long leg for a single
Abbas to Kusal Mendis, no run, fuller length delivery and angling down leg, Mendis was looking to flick and missed
Abbas to Kusal Mendis, no run, tad fuller and just outside off - a half-forward Mendis defends it towards the off-side
Abbas to Kusal Mendis, no run, beaten, on a good length and in that channel just outside off, angles in and then nips away past Mendis's defensive push
Abbas to Kusal Mendis, no run, on a good length and just outside off, Mendis prods across defensively

commentary.title: End of over 97 · 4 runs
commentary.summary: SL 393/4 · Dhananjaya de Silva · Salman Agha

commentary.text: Salman Agha to Dhananjaya, no run, tossed up just outside off, Silva defends it to the off side
Salman Agha to Dhananjaya, no run, tossed up delivery outside off, Silva gets forward and defends it
Salman Agha to Dhananjaya, no run, pushed through quicker outside off, Silva leaves it alone
Salman Agha to Dhananjaya, no run, turning in from outside off, Silva goes back and defends it
Salman Agha to Dhananjaya, no run, tossed up and turning in, Silva gets forward and defends it
Salman Agha to Dhananjaya, FOUR, a loosener to start with, drags it too short outside off, Silva rocks back and cuts it to deep extra cover
Abbas to Kusal Mendis, no run, length delivery just outside off, Mendis fends it towards cover point
Abbas to Kusal Mendis, no run, angling in from a length, Mendis works it towards short mid-wicket
Abbas to Kusal Mendis, no run, full and angling in, probing line from Abbas, Mendis blocks it solidly towards the off side
Abbas to Kusal Mendis, no run, full and tailing in, Mendis pushes it towards mid-on
Abbas to Kusal Mendis, no run, length delivery angling in, Mendis defends it to the off side
Abbas to Kusal Mendis, no run

commentary.title: End of over 95 · 9 runs
commentary.summary: SL 389/4 · Dhananjaya de Silva · Arafat Minhas

commentary.text: Arafat Minhas to Dhananjaya, FOUR, excellent shot, too full from Minhas, Silva kneels down and slog sweeps it in the air to vacant deep mid-wicket region! Runs coming thick and fast after the break
Arafat Minhas to Dhananjaya, no run, slower through the air, Silva gets forward and defends it to point
Arafat Minhas to Kusal Mendis, 1 run, floated up on off, Mendis eases it down to long-off
Arafat Minhas to Kusal Mendis, no run, flighted delivery outside off, Mendis presses forward and pushes it to covers
Arafat Minhas to Kusal Mendis, FOUR, well tossed up down the leg side, Mendis gets down to sweep, but the ball went off his gloves past the keeper to fine leg, lucky runs
Arafat Minhas to Kusal Mendis, no run, flatter and shorter on middle, Mendis goes back and defends it back to the bowler

Razaullah to Dhananjaya, 2 runs, that is good running from these two, angling into the pads, Silva works it to fine leg, the fielder was bit slow to respond and they hare back for the second. Silva dived full length forward, but the throw was not accurate
Razaullah to Dhananjaya, no run, back of a length closer to the off stump and moving away, Silva gets right behind and defends it
Razaullah to Kusal Mendis, 1 run, full and tailing in sharply, Mendis drives it to cover
Razaullah to Dhananjaya, 1 run, to mid-wicket
Razaullah to Kusal Mendis, 1 run, back of a length and moving away, Mendis guides it to backward point
Razaullah to Dhananjaya, 1 run, straying on the pads, Silva works it away to backward square leg
Abbas to Kusal Mendis, no run, good length delivery outside off and angling in, Mendis lifts his bat and lets it go
Abbas to Kusal Mendis, no run, length delivery nipping back in with an extra bounce, Mendis is hit high on the pads
Abbas to Kusal Mendis, no run, back of a length outside off and moving away, Mendis leaves it alone
Abbas to Kusal Mendis, no run, lands it on a length outside off, Mendis defends it watchfully
Abbas to Kusal Mendis, no run

Abbas to Dhananjaya, 1 run, fraction short, Silva punches it to extra cover and sets off for the single and was almost half way down the track, the fielder misses the stumps at the batter's end and they get the single eventually
Razaullah to Kusal Mendis, no run, oh this one nipped back in sharply from outside off, Mendis leaves it alone, that went mighty close to the off stump
Razaullah to Dhananjaya, leg byes, 1 run, full and tailing down the leg side, Silva misses out on the flick shot, loud appeal turned down
Razaullah to Kusal Mendis, 1 run, angling in from outside off, Mendis works it to mid-wicket

Razaullah to Kusal Mendis, FOUR, what a special shot to get to his ton, his 11th in Tests, banged in short on the stumps, Mendis arches back and upper glides it over the slip cordon to third man, takes his helmet off and acknowledges to the crowd and the dressing room
Razaullah to Dhananjaya, 1 run, fuller length delivery on off, Silva drives it to wide mid-off
Razaullah to Kusal Mendis, 1 run, back of a length and angling down the leg side, Mendis gets a faint tickle to short fine leg

commentary.title: End of over 91 · 10 runs
commentary.summary: SL 358/4 · Dhananjaya de Silva · Mohammad Abbas

commentary.text: Abbas to Dhananjaya, no run, pitched up and on off, Silva drives it towards mid-on
Abbas to Dhananjaya, no run, back of a length and angling in, Silva stays back and defends it
